description: This walk takes you along the River Avon and the Kennet and Avon Canal from Freshford to Bradford on Avon. It's a nice easy waterside walk between two attractive settlements, running for a distance of just under 3 miles. On the way you can enjoy some fine views over the water to the surrounding countryside and woodland of the area.
